components.description: Starts this flow automatically according to a configured schedule.

inputs.name: cron_expressions
inputs.info: Add one or more standard 5-field cron expressions. Each expression is evaluated in the selected timezone.

inputs.name: days_of_month
inputs.info: Select one or more calendar days. If a selected day does not exist in a month, that occurrence is skipped for that month.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.info: Enable or disable automatic scheduled execution for this flow.

inputs.name: interval_unit
inputs.info: Unit used by the interval schedule.

inputs.name: interval_value
inputs.info: Run every N interval units.

inputs.name: monthly_mode
inputs.info: Use Calendar Days for dates such as the 1st and 15th, or Weekday Occurrence for rules such as 1st Monday or Last Friday.

inputs.name: monthly_rules
inputs.info: Add monthly weekday-occurrence rules. Occurrence accepts 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, or Last. Example: 1st | Monday | 08:00.

inputs.name: runtime_data
inputs.info: Internal runtime metadata injected by the Langflow scheduler.

inputs.name: schedule_type
inputs.info: Choose how this flow should be scheduled.

inputs.name: times
inputs.info: Add one or more local execution times. Select the Hour and Minute separately; the schedule is stored internally in 24-hour HH:MM format. For Weekly and Monthly Calendar Days, every selected day uses every listed time.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.info: IANA timezone used to interpret this schedule.

inputs.name: weekdays
inputs.info: Select one or more days for a weekly schedule.

inputs.name: input_value
inputs.info: Text to be passed as input.

inputs.name: use_global_variable
inputs.info: Enable to select from global variables (shows globe icon). Disables multiline editing.

inputs.name: input_value
inputs.info: Text to be passed as output.

components.description: Receives GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE webhook requests, captures query parameters, headers, JSON, form data, raw body, files, and metadata, and exposes the complete normalized request as JSON.

inputs.name: authentication_mode
inputs.info: Platform API Key preserves the existing Langflow webhook authentication policy. External Provider allows the request through without the platform API key so the flow can perform provider-specific verification, such as Meta hub.verify_token or X-Hub-Signature-256 validation.

inputs.name: data
inputs.info: Builder/testing HTTP body only. JSON is entered as JSON; non-JSON/raw bodies may be entered as text. Fetch Latest Payload keeps form fields and uploaded files in their own fields instead of folding them into the body.

inputs.name: delete_response_body_mode
inputs.info: Response body source used when DELETE Response Mode is Immediate or After Execution. Ignored when Response Mode is From Flow.

inputs.name: delete_response_body_template
inputs.info: Used only when DELETE Response Body is Custom Template. Supports placeholders such as {{ method }}, {{ query.hub.challenge }}, {{ headers.x-event }}, {{ body.name }}, {{ form.name }}, {{ raw_body }}, and {{ metadata.content_type }}.

inputs.name: delete_response_headers
inputs.info: Additional HTTP response headers for DELETE. Standard response headers are generated automatically. Hidden when Response Mode is From Flow because Webhook Response owns the response headers.

inputs.name: delete_response_mode
inputs.info: Immediate returns this method's configured response immediately and runs the flow in the background. After Execution waits for the flow to finish, then returns this method's configured response. From Flow waits for the flow and uses a Webhook Response component to determine the HTTP response.

inputs.name: endpoint
inputs.info: Generated production webhook URL. Copy only; the URL is managed by Langflow.

inputs.name: files_data
inputs.info: Uploaded multipart files captured by the webhook. Files are saved by the backend and exposed here as JSON-safe metadata including their saved path.

inputs.name: form_data
inputs.info: Captured application/x-www-form-urlencoded or multipart/form-data fields. Fetch Latest Payload populates this separately from Body Payload.

inputs.name: get_response_body_mode

components.description: Returns a connected JSON or Message value as the Universal Webhook From Flow response body, or accepts a Response Definition containing a dynamic body, HTTP status, content type, and headers.

inputs.name: body_data
inputs.info: Connect JSON or Message. JSON objects/arrays use application/json; scalars and plain text use text/plain. Ignored when Response Definition contains a body key.

inputs.name: content_type
inputs.info: Optional explicit media type such as text/plain or application/json. Leave blank to detect it automatically. A content_type in Response Definition overrides this value.

inputs.name: response_definition
inputs.info: Optional dynamic response definition. Supported keys are body, status_code, content_type, and headers. Values supplied here override the corresponding configured fields below. This is useful for verification/validation components that must choose the HTTP status at runtime.

inputs.name: response_headers
inputs.info: Optional additional HTTP response headers. These are merged with headers from Response Definition; configured headers take precedence for duplicate names.

inputs.name: status_code
inputs.info: Default HTTP status returned to the webhook caller. A status_code in Response Definition overrides this value.
